spans.text: Yiriba na bà sikindo dare bà mɛɛri, da seena yirimma mii bà ta da i nɛki bà tɔɔba.

entries.description: Fɔ da sooki da i o daarina
entries.subject: Fɔ da

spans.text: Yirisaro ba o wan, nɛɛ o ta bo, da nɛkidi o i yinri maa o ta da i Fɔ da sooki da i o daarina.
Yiraba mɛ-di bà maasi booti yaama consiroma mii, batisima paa.

entries.description: o pɛɛ yaama sa o maa ba wɛ̃ɛnu
entries.subject: o pɛɛ

spans.text: Yirisaro ba o wan bà ka o pɛɛ yaama sa o maa ba wɛ̃ɛnu; bootidamu teera yɛɛmbɛ bà o ǹ yire ma mii.

entries.description: yì yeema sooki ma i daari-na
entries.subject: yì yeema

spans.text: Yirisaro ba o wan o tan da sooki-di o yori maa ota bansiti yirikutire-mii, yì yeema sooki ma i daari-na.

entries.description: yuŋi kaatorede mii o ta nɛki
entries.subject: yuŋi kaatorede

spans.text: Yirisaro ba o wan o ǹ baŋa ka o pɛ, o da sooki-di o yuŋi kaatorede mii o ta nɛki.
Yirisaro, da nɛki o i yinri maa o ǹ tinkpaande yaama ta coonni, o i pukiri yerisu su den nɔɔre dè tan tara o peeke.

entries.description: tɔɔba Fɔɔku sooki ku yì bà daari-na
entries.subject: tɔɔba Fɔɔku

spans.text: Yirisaro yon wɛ̃ɛrun ba o ǹ sɛku boma mii, da seena yiriba ta da i tetina bà tɔɔba Fɔɔku sooki ku yì bà daari-na.
Kɔɔrima takoma-di da seke yiro ǹ tana simma, o sooki o Fɛtima o ǹ yon o nɛkɛ na yirisari tɔ, Fɔɔku sooki ku i daari-na ãduriya mii.

entries.description: yi yeriŋa sooki ka i coonna tirima
entries.subject: yi yeriŋa

spans.text: Na tɔɔba kari yi ta ka pukiri, yi cɔntu i mɛɛ, yi nɔɔya i mɛɛ, yi yeriŋa sooki ka i coonna tirima.
